provisionalSurvivor.name: Action/Effect Events + Outcome/Attribution Projections
provisionalSurvivor.compression: Conversion is not one success pipeline. Selection may commit an Action; owner-native Effect events/claims preserve what directly happened or remains unknown; domain-owned Outcome projections evaluate consequences under objective/observer/horizon/context; Attribution is a separate causal claim; Knowledge requires semantic promotion and may arise from successful, failed, invalid or uncertain evidence. Consumption is family-specific accounting parallel to the attempt/effect window. Relations are many-to-many and exogenous effects/outcomes are allowed.

centralResult: Conversion is not one universal success pipeline. Action, direct Effect, domain Outcome, causal Attribution and promoted Knowledge are distinct truths with different owners; Consumption is resource-family-specific accounting, and relations are many-to-many with exogenous Effects/Outcomes permitted.

rootCompression.action: identity-bound admitted/committed attempt to cause or obtain a transition
rootCompression.effect: owner-native direct consequence Event/Claim, including success/failure/no-effect/unknown
rootCompression.outcome: domain-owned evaluation projection over Effects plus exogenous facts under objective/observer/horizon/comparison/evidence context
rootCompression.attribution: separate causal/credit/blame Claim with explicit evidence/uncertainty
rootCompression.knowledge: semantically promoted reusable Claim/model/procedure that changes future prediction/selection/verification/recovery and may arise from success or failure
rootCompression.consumption: resource-family-specific Event/quantity/reservation/depletion relation parallel to Action/Effect, not a universal lifecycle stage
rootCompression.cardinality: many-to-many; Outcome need not have Agent Action ancestry

productionDebt.currentConsumptionOutcome: Current `ConsumptionOutcome(resource_id, workload_id, useful, value)` is a useful narrow ranking prior but not a general Outcome model.
productionDebt.probe: R6P03 proves it collapses excellent+failed bimodal history and one moderate useful observation to identical potential/evidence/decision under equal other facts.
productionDebt.decision: Record debt only. Do not replace it with a universal Outcome schema in R6.

next: R7 resource ecology dynamics: stock/flow/capacity/budget/rate, consumption/reservation/depletion, renewal/decay/reacquisition, resource-producing actions/effects and recursive feedback, after canonical main revalidation.
